topic_title: Emergency Control: Skids, Blowouts & Brake Failure
prompt: If the vehicle accelerator pedal jams wide open at highway speeds, what is the safest immediate action?

options.text: Turn ignition key completely to off position and remove key from cylinder
Reach down with both hands to dislodge floor mat while looking at pedal
Drive into the rear bumper of a lead commercial truck to absorb speed
Shift transmission into neutral, apply firm steady brakes, and steer to shoulder
